# Kanye Ranker

> Kanye Ranker (https://www.kanyeranker.com/) is a free web app that ranks Kanye West songs by personal taste. It shows two songs at a time, the user picks one, and an Elo rating turns those picks into a personal Top 10 songs and Top 5 albums that can be shared as an image. No account or sign-up.

## How it works

- Each comparison shows two Kanye West songs; pick one or skip. Keyboard: Left/1, Right/2, Space/S to skip
- Every song starts at the same rating; picks move ratings using Elo, the system used for chess players
- Results unlock after 20 comparisons; ranking can continue as long as the user wants
- Popular songs appear first, then closer matchups as the list takes shape
- Users can request specific songs mid-session, undo the last pick, and watch a YouTube clip for many songs
- Nothing is saved to a server; each visit starts fresh

## Coverage

198 of Kanye West's most-streamed songs across 17 albums:

- The College Dropout (2004)
- Late Registration (2005)
- Graduation (2007)
- 808s & Heartbreak (2008)
- My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy (2010)
- Watch the Throne (2011)
- Cruel Summer (2012)
- Yeezus (2013)
- The Life of Pablo (2016)
- ye (2018)
- Kids See Ghosts (2018)
- Jesus Is King (2019)
- Donda (2021)
- Donda 2 (2022)
- Vultures 1 (2024)
- Vultures 2 (2024)
- Bully (2026)
